name: MeasureTheory
integral_mul_norm_le_Lp_mul_Lq
result.signature:
{E} [NormedAddCommGroup E] {f g : α → E} {p q : ℝ} (hpq : p.HolderConjugate q) (hf : MemLp f (ENNReal.ofReal p) μ)
  (hg : MemLp g (ENNReal.ofReal q) μ) :
  ∫ a, ‖f a‖ * ‖g a‖ ∂μ ≤ (∫ a, ‖f a‖ ^ p ∂μ) ^ (1 / p) * (∫ a, ‖g a‖ ^ q ∂μ) ^ (1 / q)
result.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {m : MeasurableSpace α} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} {E : Type u_6} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  {f g : α → E} {p q : ℝ},
  p.HolderConjugate q →
    MeasureTheory.MemLp f (ENNReal.ofReal p) μ →
      MeasureTheory.MemLp g (ENNReal.ofReal q) μ →
        ∫ (a : α), ‖f a‖ * ‖g a‖ ∂μ ≤ (∫ (a : α), ‖f a‖ ^ p ∂μ) ^ (1 / p) * (∫ (a : α), ‖g a‖ ^ q ∂μ) ^ (1 / q)
result.value:
:= by
  -- translate the Bochner integrals into Lebesgue integrals.
  
  rw [integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae, integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae, integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae]
  rotate_left
  · exact Eventually.of_forall fun x => Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _
  · exact (hg.1.norm.aemeasurable.pow aemeasurable_const).aestronglyMeasurable
  · exact Eventually.of_forall fun x => Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _
  · exact (hf.1.norm.aemeasurable.pow aemeasurable_const).aestronglyM...
result.informal_description: For Hölder conjugate exponents $ p $ and $ q $ (i.e., $ \frac{1}{p} + \frac{1}{q} = 1 $), if $ f \in L^p(\mu, E) $ and $ g \in L^q(\mu, E) $, then the integral of the product of their norms satisfies $ \int \|f(a)\| \cdot \|g(a)\| \, d\mu(a) \leq \left(\int \|f(a)\|^p \, d\mu(a)\right)^{1/p} \cdot \left(\int \|g(a)\|^q \, d\mu(a)\right)^{1/q} $.

name: Real
sum_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt
result.signature: (s : Finset ι) (f g : ι → ℝ) : ∑ i ∈ s, f i * g i ≤ √(∑ i ∈ s, f i ^ 2) * √(∑ i ∈ s, g i ^ 2)
result.type: ∀ {ι : Type u_2} (s : Finset ι) (f g : ι → ℝ), ∑ i ∈ s, f i * g i ≤ √(∑ i ∈ s, f i ^ 2) * √(∑ i ∈ s, g i ^ 2)
result.informal_description: For any finite set $ s $ of indices $ \iota $ and functions $ f, g : \iota \to \mathbb{R} $, the inequality $ \sum_{i \in s} f(i) \cdot g(i) \leq \sqrt{\sum_{i \in s} [f(i)]^2} \cdot \sqrt{\sum_{i \in s} [g(i)]^2} $ holds.

name: MeasureTheory
MemLp
integrable_mul
result.signature: {p q : ℝ≥0∞} {f g : α → 𝕜} (hf : MemLp f p μ) (hg : MemLp g q μ) [HolderTriple p q 1] : Integrable (f * g) μ
result.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {m : MeasurableSpace α} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} {𝕜 : Type u_8} [inst : NormedRing 𝕜]
  {p q : ENNReal} {f g : α → 𝕜},
  MeasureTheory.MemLp f p μ → MeasureTheory.MemLp g q μ → ∀ [p.HolderTriple q 1], MeasureTheory.Integrable (f * g) μ
result.informal_name: Hölder's Inequality for Integrability of Product
result.informal_description: If functions $f$ and $g$ belong to $L^p$ and $L^q$ spaces respectively with conjugate exponents $p$ and $q$ (i.e., $1/p + 1/q = 1$) over a measure space $(\alpha, \mu)$, then their pointwise product $f \cdot g$ is an integrable function with respect to the measure $\mu$.

name: NNReal
sum_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt
result.signature: (s : Finset ι) (f g : ι → ℝ≥0) : ∑ i ∈ s, f i * g i ≤ sqrt (∑ i ∈ s, f i ^ 2) * sqrt (∑ i ∈ s, g i ^ 2)
result.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_2} (s : Finset ι) (f g : ι → NNReal),
  ∑ i ∈ s, f i * g i ≤ NNReal.sqrt (∑ i ∈ s, f i ^ 2) * NNReal.sqrt (∑ i ∈ s, g i ^ 2)
result.informal_name: Cauchy-Schwarz Inequality for Non-negative Real Numbers
result.informal_description: For any finite set $s$ of indices $\iota$ and functions $f, g : \iota \to \mathbb{R}_{\geq 0}$, the inequality $\sum_{i \in s} f(i)g(i) \leq \sqrt{\sum_{i \in s} f(i)^2} \cdot \sqrt{\sum_{i \in s} g(i)^2}$ holds, where the square roots denote the principal non-negative square roots defined on $\mathbb{R}_{\geq 0}$.

name: Finset
expect_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq
result.signature: (s : Finset ι) (f g : ι → R) : (𝔼 i ∈ s, f i * g i) ^ 2 ≤ (𝔼 i ∈ s, f i ^ 2) * 𝔼 i ∈ s, g i ^ 2
result.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R]
  [ExistsAddOfLE R] [inst_4 : Module ℚ≥0 R] [PosSMulMono ℚ≥0 R] (s : Finset ι) (f g : ι → R),
  (s.expect fun i => f i * g i) ^ 2 ≤ (s.expect fun i => f i ^ 2) * s.expect fun i => g i ^ 2
result.value:
:= by
  simp only [expect, smul_pow, inv_pow, smul_mul_smul_comm, ← sq]
  gcongr
  exact sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq ..
result.informal_name: Cauchy-Schwarz Inequality for Expectations over Finite Sets
result.informal_description: For any finite set $ s $ of type $\iota$ and functions $ f, g : \iota \to R $, the square of the expectation of the product $ f(i)g(i) $ is less than or equal to the product of the expectations of $ f(i)^2 $ and $ g(i)^2 $. Formally, $\left(\mathbb{E}_{i \in s} [f(i)g(i)]\right)^2 \leq \left(\mathbb{E}_{i \in s} [f(i)^2]\right) \cdot \left(\mathbb{E}_{i \in s} [g(i)^2]\right)$.
